text: By this method, through the practice of examining the twenty-five tattvas, this nature is understood as the Self (Purusha), and these five tanmatras, five sense organs, and five great elements are understood as belonging to the Self. Thus, knowledge of the Self arises: “I am not this; I am not this body; that is not me; I am other; this body is other; I am not this.” Thereupon, a state free from all traces of egoism and free from all delusion arises. It is purified by being free from delusion, and purified by being free from doubt. The knowledge that “only that exists, and nothing else” arises, which is the cause of liberation. This knowledge, the knowledge of the twenty-five tattvas, is the knowledge of the Self.
